span.div:
2. Sydney App receives request
├─ Is this a critical write? Yes
├─ Active-passive setup: all writes to primary
└─ Primary is us-east-1 (Virginia)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
4. us-east-1 validates:
├─ Sender has 5000 balance (reads local primary)
├─ Recipient exists (reads local primary)
├─ Not a duplicate (idempotency key check in DB)
└─ All checks pass

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
5. Execute write:
BEGIN TRANSACTION
├─ Debit sender account: 5000 - 500 = 4500
├─ Credit recipient: balance + 500
└─ Insert transaction record
COMMIT

span.div:
7. Sydney App renders success page to user
Total write latency: ~200ms (150ms cross-region + 50ms
processing including validation and commit)
8. Async replication starts:
us-east-1 primary streams WAL to:
├─ eu-west-1 read replica (transatlantic, ~80ms lag)
├─ ap-southeast-1 read replica (pacific, ~150ms lag)
└─ ap-southeast-2 read replica (transpacific, ~130ms lag)
